transcript.text: Researchers actually had people try a
small price wine, a medium price wine,
an expensive wine, and rate them. And
people said this was the worst, this was
the middle, and this was the best. But
the crazy part is is that the expensive
wine and the cheap wine were the exact
same wine. They just put them in a
different sleeve. That means that for
us, if you just want people to like your
stuff more, maybe just raise your price.
